Dear classmates,

I am writing to invite you to take part in a campus volunteer activity organized by our class. The activity will be held on Saturday morning, March 15th, at the city library near our campus.

During the activity, we will help the librarians sort books, guide readers to find what they need, and read stories to children. It is a good chance to serve others and gain practical experience at the same time.

If you would like to join us, please reply to this email before Wednesday. I am looking forward to your participation.

Yours sincerely,
Li Ming
